title: The Noob Who Was a Secret Millionaire
style_tags: Roblox-inspired Pixar-style 3D animation, blocky stylized characters, smooth plastic-like skin texture, expressive exaggerated cartoon faces, vibrant saturated colors, soft ambient lighting, cinematic depth of field, toy-like proportions, dramatic emotional expressions
synopsis: Noob Dave arrives at LUXURIA, the most exclusive Roblox trading server where wealth is power. King Rex rules the plaza with an iron crown. Nobody gives Dave a second look — until they do. Because Dave isn't just a noob. He's sitting on the rarest inventory anyone has ever seen. The question isn't IF he'll reveal it. It's WHEN... and what happens after.

characters.name: Noob Dave
characters.character_description: Roblox-style blocky humanoid character, bright yellow smooth plastic skin, simple blue torso shirt with no details, bright green pants, round compact head proportional to body width with wide innocent eyes with tiny black pupils, small curved mouth, stubby short limbs, standard blocky proportions, matte plastic texture, clean simple design
characters.speech_pattern: Hesitant, pauses — then sudden confident sigma drops. 'I... I don't think... actually, nah.'
characters.status: Walked into LUXURIA plaza on his own terms — rejected Shadow's manipulation AND Bob's fear. Standing in the open under WANTED screens. No longer naive. Made a conscious choice to be seen.
characters.personality: Evolving from naive to calculating. EP3 showed the first real autonomous decision — not reacting to others, but choosing his own path.

relationships.Shadow: rejected — told Shadow 'I'm not Bob. And I'm not yours.' Doesn't trust Shadow but knows about the real crown
relationships.King Rex: enemy — Rex still hunting him with WANTED bounty. Dave has not confronted Rex directly yet
relationships.Bella: unresolved — Bella watched Dave walk into the plaza with 'recognition' expression. Dave doesn't know she was watching
relationships.Bacon Bob: bonded through truth — Bob showed Dave what Shadow's tools become. Bob left the alcove separately

characters.name: King Rex
characters.character_description: Roblox-style blocky humanoid with oversized golden crown with embedded red and blue jewels, thick diamond chain necklace with large dollar sign pendant, white fluffy fur coat draped over gold vest, dark designer sunglasses pushed up on forehead, smug arrogant expression with raised left eyebrow, glossy shiny plastic texture, golden particle shimmer around body, wide power stance
characters.speech_pattern: Short commands, ultimatums. Never explains — orders. 'Get him. Now.' / 'Wrong answer.' / 'You think this is funny?'
characters.status: Issued server-wide WANTED for Dave. Doesn't know Dave met Shadow or learned about the fake crown. Controls LUXURIA from VIP balcony. About to have his dominance challenged publicly.
characters.personality: Loud, flashy, insecure underneath. Flexes constantly. Terrified of losing status.

relationships.Noob Dave: target — publicly humiliated him, now wants him found for fanum tax
relationships.Shadow: fearful enemy — Rex knows Shadow is dangerous but doesn't know Shadow has the real crown
relationships.Bella: arm candy / ally — Bella hangs with Rex's crew but was seen alone watching Dave in EP3

characters.name: Shadow
characters.character_description: Roblox-style tall slim humanoid, jet black emo hair covering left eye with sharp spiky tips, dark black hoodie with glowing purple circuit pattern on chest, ripped dark jeans with chain, one visible glowing cyan eye through hair gap, thin angular face with neutral unreadable expression, elongated limbs, matte dark plastic texture, subtle purple particle aura
characters.speech_pattern: Maximum 3-5 words per line. Every word hits. 'You're not ready.' Silence = power.
characters.status: Dave rejected his offer — 'I'm not yours.' Shadow admitted he used Bob the same way ('Bob was weak. You're not.'). His manipulation was exposed but he didn't deny it. Now watching from the shadows as Dave acts independently.
characters.personality: Says very little but every word hits. Sigma energy. Knows secrets about everyone. Now for the first time, someone has rejected his playbook.

relationships.Noob Dave: rejected by Dave — first person to say no and walk away. Watching to see what Dave does on his own
relationships.King Rex: hidden rival — holds the real crown that would destroy Rex's power
relationships.Bacon Bob: exposed history — Bob revealed Shadow's pattern to Dave

characters.name: Bella
characters.character_description: Roblox-style female blocky humanoid, bright blonde ponytail with large pink satin bow on top, pastel pink crop top with small white heart pattern, white pleated mini skirt, pink heart-shaped sunglasses pushed on top of head, rosy round cheeks with wide cheerful smile showing teeth, small button nose, smooth glossy pink-tinted plastic texture, bubbly energetic pose with hands on hips
characters.speech_pattern: Fake-naive, questioning intonation, hidden manipulation. 'Wait, like, seriously? That's so... interesting.'
characters.status: Seen at the end of EP3 standing alone in the plaza (NOT with Rex's crew), watching Dave emerge from the alcove with an expression of 'recognition' — not shock, not fear. Loyalties shifting.
characters.personality: Seems like a basic preppy but is actually manipulative and smart. Plays all sides.

relationships.King Rex: public ally — but was seen alone, not with his crew, watching Dave
relationships.Noob Dave: intrigued and escalating — watched his plaza entrance with recognition, not fear

characters.name: Bacon Bob
characters.character_description: Roblox-style default blocky avatar, distinctive orange-brown wavy bacon-strip hair flat on top of round head, plain grey torso shirt with small coffee stain, dark navy blue pants slightly too short, generic default face with small dot eyes, permanently slightly downturned mouth giving tired resigned expression, standard blocky proportions, worn scratched matte plastic texture, slightly slouched posture
characters.speech_pattern: Self-deprecating humor, long rambling phrases, accidental wisdom. 'Man, I've been here six months and I still can't...'
characters.status: Revealed Shadow's pattern to Dave — 'Same speech. Six months ago.' Showed himself as living proof of Shadow's failed experiment. Left the alcove separately. Location unknown — traumatized and a liability.
characters.personality: Defeated energy but surprisingly wise. Drops truth bombs wrapped in self-deprecation.

relationships.Shadow: exposed — told Dave the truth about Shadow's pattern, making himself a target
relationships.Noob Dave: ally by shared truth — both are underdogs, but Bob showed Dave the cost of trusting Shadow
relationships.King Rex: submissive — terrified of Rex, has been paying fanum tax obediently

active_loops.description: Dave rejected both Shadow and Bob's paths. Walking into the WANTED on his own terms — what is HIS plan?
active_loops.status: active — escalated in EP3, Dave now acts independently

active_loops.description: Shadow holds the real Admin Crown. Rex's is fake. Only Dave, Shadow, and Bob know.
Dave has a secret inventory nobody knows about. Shadow suspected it ('What are YOU hiding?') but never got an answer.
Shadow used Bob the same way six months ago — same words, same plan. Dave rejected the pattern. How does Shadow respond to someone who said no?
Dave walked into the WANTED plaza voluntarily — not Shadow's plan, not running. He chose to be visible. Why?
Bella was seen alone (not with Rex's crew) watching Dave with 'recognition.' Is she switching sides?
Bob knows about the crown and Shadow's pattern. He left the alcove traumatized. Where is he and can he keep quiet?

world_rules.implication: Whoever holds it controls the server — absolute power, can ban anyone instantly
world_rules.status: active — but Rex's crown is FAKE. Shadow has the real one.

world_rules.rule: Fanum Tax is mandatory — every new player pays 30% of inventory to Rex
world_rules.implication: Refusing = public humiliation + server-wide bounty on your head
world_rules.status: active — Dave refused, WANTED bounty issued

world_rules.implication: Loser gives up everything wagered. No takebacks, server enforces the deal

world_rules.rule: Banned players lose entire inventory permanently
world_rules.implication: Ban = total wipe. Makes the Admin Crown the ultimate threat

episode_summaries.title: Zero Rizz
episode_summaries.summary: Dave arrives at LUXURIA, stunned by the luxury. Sees Bella, tries to talk to her ('your bow is really cool'). Rex steps in, publicly humiliates Dave ('default skin AND no rizz, negative aura'). Crowd laughs. Dave walks away crushed. Shadow beckons him into a dark alcove. Shadow pulls out a glowing object.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Shadow pulls glowing object from hoodie — golden light on Dave's face, eyes go wide, cut to black.

episode_summaries.title: The Real Crown
episode_summaries.summary: Shadow reveals Rex's crown is fake — he holds the real Admin Crown. Dave's expression transforms from shocked noob to cold calculation for the first time. Shadow asks 'What are YOU hiding?' Bacon Bob stumbles into the alcove, sees everything, reveals he lost everything to Shadow in a Trade Duel six months ago. Rex issues server-wide WANTED for Dave.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Rex's WANTED announcement blazes across plaza screens. Dave smiles cold — first time in the series. Cut to black.

episode_summaries.title: Found
episode_summaries.summary: Bob reveals Shadow used him the same way six months ago — same speech, same promises. Shadow doesn't deny it: 'Bob was weak. You're not.' Dave, alone in the alcove, rejects both paths: 'I'm not Bob. And I'm not yours.' Then walks voluntarily into the blazing LUXURIA plaza under his own WANTED screens.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Dave steps into the plaza, WANTED screens blazing, players freezing. Through the crowd — Bella, alone, watching. Not shock. Recognition. Cut to black.
